## Test Suite Information

### RV32I Base Integer (rv32ui)
Tests the base 32-bit RISC-V integer instruction set including:
- Arithmetic operations (ADD, SUB, etc.)
- Logical operations (AND, OR, XOR, etc.)
- Shifts (SLL, SRL, SRA)
- Comparisons (SLT, SLTU)
- Branches (BEQ, BNE, BLT, BGE, BLTU, BGEU)
- Jumps (JAL, JALR)
- Loads/Stores (LB, LH, LW, LBU, LHU, SB, SH, SW)
- Upper immediates (LUI, AUIPC)

### RV32M Multiply/Divide Extension (rv32um)
Tests the multiply and divide instructions:
- MUL, MULH, MULHSU, MULHU
- DIV, DIVU, REM, REMU

## Compliance Information

These tests are from the official RISC-V architectural test suite 
(`riscv-tests`), which verifies ISA compliance against the RISC-V 
specification. Passing these tests demonstrates that IronCore correctly 
implements the RV32IM subset of the supported RV64IM architecture.
